div.head: I Cn 5.3
div.ab: And gyf mæssepreost æfre ahwær stande on leasre gewitnesse oððe on mænan aðe oððe þeofa gewita oððe gewyrhta beo, þonne sy he aworpen of gehadodra gemanan ⁊ þolige ægþer ge geferscipes ge freondscipes ge æghwylces weorðscipes, butan he wið God ⁊ wið menn þe deoplicor gebete, swa bisceop him tæce, ⁊ him borh finde, þæt he þanon forð æfre swylces geswice.

And gif mæssepreost æfre ahwer stande on leasre gewittnesse oððe on mænan aðe oððe þeofa gewita oððe gewyrhta beo, þonne sy he aworpen of gehadodra gemanan ⁊ þolige ægðer [ge] geferscipes ge freondscipes ge æghwilces weorðscipes, buton he wið Godd ⁊ wið menn þe deoplicor gebete, swa biscop him tæce, ⁊ him borh finde, þæt he þanon forð æfre swilces geswice.

Si sacerdos aliquando falsus testis uel periurus extiterit uel furtum fecerit uel in aliquo consenserit, deponatur et omni bonorum societate, dilectione careat et honore, si non erga Deum et homines dignis penitentię fructibus secundum episcopi sui iussionem preparetur ad ueniam, et emendationis et legalitatis plegios deinceps inueniat.

And gyf mæssepreost æfre ahwær stande on leasre gewitnesse oððe on mænan aðe oððe ðeofa gewita oððe gewyrhta beo, þonne sy he aworpen of gehadodra gemanan ⁊ þolige ægþer ge geferscipes ge freondscipes ge æghwylces weorðscipes, butan he wið God ⁊ wið menn þe deoplicor gebete, swa bisceop him tæce, ⁊ him borh finde þæt he þanon forð æfre swylces geswice.

And if a priest anywhere be concerned in false witness or perjury, or be the accessory and accomplice of thieves, he shall be cast out from the fellowship of those in holy orders and shall forfeit both their society and their friendship and every kind of privilege, unless he make amends, both towards God and towards men, to the utmost of his ability, as the bishop shall prescribe for him, and find surety that henceforth he will cease for ever from all such [wrong-doing].

Und wenn ein Priester je irgendwo in falschem Zeugniss oder im Meineid [ertappt] dasteht, oder Mitwisser von Dieben oder Mitwirker ist, dann sei er verstossen aus Gemeinschaft der Geistlichen und verliere sowohl [deren] Genossenschaft wie Freundschaft und jeden Ehrenrang, ausser wenn er gegenüber Gott und Weltlichen um so tiefer büsst, wie [sein] Bischof ihm vorschreibt, und Bürgschaft für sich findet [dafür], dass er stets hinfort von solchem [Verbrechen] ablassen werde.

And if a priest anywhere stands [convicted] of false witness or perjury, or is an accessory or accomplice of thieves, then let him be cast out of the fellowship of the clergy and lose both [their] fellowship and friendship and every honour, unless he makes all the deeper amends before God and men, as [his] bishop prescribes for him, and finds surety [to the effect] that he will forever desist from such [crimes].
div.note: Liebermann supplies ‘ge’ in A. Liebermann compares VIII Atr 27.
